thesis: The episode explores how AI is reshaping consumer technology, creativity, and product building, featuring insights from Kevin Rose and Anish Acharia on their history at Google and Google Ventures. It also examines the cultural significance of early internet innovations like the like button and the importance of being willing to be embarrassed in consumer investing.
